mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures over three months signals a weakening demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL growth below 2% annually, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods with low inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GDP and falling unemployment rate signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
